title.zh: 普维柚 · 霜刑储备与风底异放
title.en: Promeia / Velina / Yuzuha · Trial reserves and Wind-backed Abloom

summary.zh: 柚刷新后让普罗米娅先染色；维琳娜以风华开气旋并向上一位交棒，主攻按真实资源兑现异放。
summary.en: After Yuzuha refreshes, Promeia colors first. Velina uses Windbloom for Cyclones and assists the previous slot; the main attacker spends actual resources for Abloom.

conditions.zh: 循环站位普罗米娅→维琳娜→柚叶，可整体旋转；柚下切、维上切都回主攻。
conditions.en: Cyclic order Promeia→Velina→Yuzuha, with equivalent rotations; Yuzuha assists next and Velina previous to the main attacker.

conditions.zh: 来源为作者3.0队伍教学，普罗动作逐条核当前固定技能；不将作者口语90能量当90风华，也不收录潜能维柏路线。
conditions.en: Based on the authored 3.0 team route, with Promeia actions checked against fixed skills; do not equate 90 energy with 90 Windbloom or import the awakened Burnice route.

conditions.zh: 教学适用于固定Gachabase正式3.3基础技能；默认0影无专武，不启用潜能觉醒。
conditions.en: Uses fixed Gachabase release 3.3 base skills; M0 without signatures by default, with no Potential awakening.

conditions.zh: 按实际资源、敌人异常、失衡与提示执行；没有固定秒数、帧数、连携次数或最高分承诺。
conditions.en: Follow actual resources, Anomaly, Stun and prompts; no fixed seconds, frames, Chain count or maximum-score claim.

label.zh: Asgater · 维爱队／维普队操作（3.0）
label.en: Asgater · Aria/Velina and Promeia/Velina routes (3.0)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 维琳娜风华与气旋（3.0）
label.en: Orange · Velina Windbloom and Cyclones (3.0)

label.zh: 普罗米娅 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Promeia · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 维琳娜 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Velina · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 柚叶 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Yuzuha · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 先染色、准备主攻资源，再铺气旋。
objective.en: Color first, prepare main-attacker resources, then establish Cyclone.

title.zh: 柚EX刷新后让普罗米娅先染冰
title.en: Refresh with Yuzuha EX, then let Promeia color Ice

input.zh: 普通切柚，有能量点按EX；命中后按主攻实际支援／连携提示择一。
input.en: Switch normally to Yuzuha, tap an affordable EX, then choose the main attacker’s actual assist or Chain prompt.

trigger.zh: 狸之愿／惊吓／甜度点需要补；已有正确覆盖不必重复刷新。
trigger.en: Tanuki Wish, Sweet Scare or Sugar Points need refreshing; do not repeat valid setup unnecessarily.

complete.zh: 发动加2甜度点；重击挂惊吓，命中提供增益／提示；重新挂惊吓会清除原染色。
complete.en: Activation gives two Sugar Points; the heavy hit applies Sweet Scare and the hit grants buff/prompt. Reapplying Sweet Scare clears the old color.

reason.zh: 下一位是普罗米娅，先用自身冰攻击命中，避免维琳娜抢先染风。
reason.en: Promeia is next; land their matching Ice hit before Velina can color Wind.

fallback.zh: 没能量先让主攻回能；已有正确染色时可跳过本段，普通切所需角色。柚2强制连携不等于敌人失衡。
fallback.en: If energy is short, recover on the main attacker. Skip this segment if color/setup suffice and switch normally as needed. Yuzuha M2 forced Chain is not enemy Stun.

signal.zh: 只接主攻实际快支／连携；重新染色必须先由主攻同属性命中。
signal.en: Take only the actual main-attacker assist/Chain; their matching hit must recolor first.

title.zh: 按提示接主攻：快支／连携择一
title.en: Enter the main attacker once: Quick Assist or Chain

input.zh: 快支出现就响应主攻快支；若实际出现连携窗口则选主攻连携。本事件只执行其中一种。
input.en: Respond to the main attacker’s Quick Assist; if an actual Chain window appears, select their Chain instead. Execute exactly one entry.

trigger.zh: 提示实际指向主攻；柚的下一位、维琳娜的上一位都由固定循环站位保证。
trigger.en: The actual prompt targets the main attacker; cyclic order makes them next after Yuzuha and previous before Velina.

complete.zh: 自身冰命中建立／维持对应染色；连携重击命中异常目标才触发异放；快支不当作连携异放。
complete.en: A matching Ice hit establishes/maintains color; Chain heavy hit needs an Anomalous target for Abloom; Quick Assist is not Chain Abloom.

reason.zh: 不把普通切人、快支、强制连携与真实失衡混为一谈。
reason.en: Keep normal switching, Quick Assist, forced Chain and actual enemy Stun distinct.

fallback.zh: 无提示就跳过并普通切主攻，用合法本属性攻击接续；不能为凑轴凭空触发连携。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, skip and switch normally to the main attacker, then use a legal matching-attribute attack. Never invent a Chain to complete the sequence.

actionLabel.zh: 快速支援／连携（按实际提示择一）
actionLabel.en: Quick Assist / Chain Attack (choose the actual prompt)

label.zh: 冰彩糖花火 · 惊吓与正确染色仍在时
label.en: Ice Sugarburst · only while Sweet Scare and the correct color remain

label.zh: 气旋 · 以当前实际存续为准；消散异放还要求目标有风异常
label.en: Cyclone · only while actually present; its expiry Abloom requires a Wind-Anomalous target

title.zh: 普罗普攻与实有触发攒寒蚀／霜刑
title.en: Build Promeia Corrosive Chill and Trial by Cold from actual hits

input.zh: 用普通攻击积蓄；红光用真实闪避／反击。需要补气旋时普通切维琳娜。
input.en: Build with Basics; dodge/counter actual red attacks. Switch normally to Velina when Cyclone setup needs refreshing.

trigger.zh: 染色正确、辅助覆盖已确认；需要补主攻资源或异常积蓄。
trigger.en: Color and support coverage are confirmed; the main attacker needs resources or Anomaly buildup.

complete.zh: 观察寒蚀与霜刑：寒蚀每50转1霜刑，霜刑最多2；开战有2霜刑。披风切割与长普旋刃命中不回寒蚀。
complete.en: Read both resources: 50 Corrosive Chill converts to one Trial by Cold, capped at two; battle entry grants two. Cloak cutting and held Whirling Blade hits do not restore Chill.

reason.zh: 失衡前尽量准备霜刑与寒蚀，但按当前库存输出；满霜刑后可再积蓄寒蚀，不把“100寒蚀+2霜刑”当开局赠送。
reason.en: Prepare Trial and Chill before Stun, but work from actual stock. Chill may accumulate once Trial is full; 100 Chill plus two Trial is not a free starting state.

fallback.zh: 惊吓／增益将断则回柚刷新并由主攻重新染色；没有可招架攻击就普通切维琳娜并跳过招架动作。
fallback.en: Refresh Yuzuha when Sweet Scare/buffs lapse, then recolor with the main attacker. Without a parryable attack, switch normally to Velina and skip Defensive Assist.

signal.zh: 主攻准备好后，普通切维琳娜。
signal.en: After main-attacker preparation, switch normally to Velina.

label.zh: 冰彩糖花火 · 惊吓与正确染色仍在时
label.en: Ice Sugarburst · only while Sweet Scare and the correct color remain

label.zh: 气旋 · 以当前实际存续为准；消散异放还要求目标有风异常
label.en: Cyclone · only while actually present; its expiry Abloom requires a Wind-Anomalous target

title.zh: 缺风华才用扬清补，能量与风华分开看
title.en: Use Purifying Rise if Windbloom is short; track energy separately

input.zh: 普通切入维琳娜或完成合法招架后，有能量点按EX扬清；确需再补且能量够，可随后再按EX三重绝息。
input.en: After normal entry or a valid Defensive Assist, tap an affordable Purifying Rise. If more is needed and energy permits, follow it with Triple Deathblow.

trigger.zh: 准备释放风暴眼而风华不足90；现有风华够时可省略补充。
trigger.en: Eye of the Storm is needed but Windbloom is below 90; skip replenishing when it already suffices.

complete.zh: 扬清／三重绝息发动各加45风华，上限135；开战基础45。看当前风华，不用能量条冒充。
complete.en: Each Purifying Rise/Triple Deathblow activation gives 45 Windbloom, cap 135, with 45 at baseline battle entry. Read Windbloom, not the energy bar.

reason.zh: 原文口语中的“90能量”不当成风暴眼门槛；当前固定技能明确要求90风华。
reason.en: Do not treat the article’s shorthand “90 energy” as the gate: the fixed skill explicitly requires 90 Windbloom.

fallback.zh: 缺能量且风华不足就普通切主攻继续正常积蓄，下一步风暴眼与快支一起跳过；已有90风华也先普通切到维琳娜，仅跳过补EX，再接下一步。
fallback.en: If energy and Windbloom are both short, switch normally to the main attacker and skip the next Cyclone/assist segment. With 90 Windbloom already, still switch normally to Velina; skip only the refill EX and proceed.

title.zh: 风华够90再开风暴眼，回支主攻
title.en: At 90 Windbloom, summon the Cyclone and assist back

input.zh: 确认风华≥90，长按特殊技或普攻发动风暴眼，随后按主攻实际提示。
input.en: Confirm at least 90 Windbloom, hold Special or Basic for Eye of the Storm, then take the main attacker’s actual prompt.

trigger.zh: 维琳娜已在前场且风华满足；气旋已够用时别无脑重复覆盖。
trigger.en: Velina is active with sufficient Windbloom; avoid overwriting adequate Cyclone coverage unnecessarily.

complete.zh: 生成广域气旋并触发上一位主攻快支；首次命中浸染目标才确认赋彩，普通命中不等于已有风异常。
complete.en: Summon Sweeping Cyclone and trigger the previous main attacker’s Quick Assist. Chromatic Tint requires its first hit on a Contaminated enemy; an ordinary hit does not prove Wind Anomaly.

reason.zh: 交棒后气旋在实际持续时间内继续作用；0影赋彩不直接按2影的对应属性积蓄计算。
reason.en: The Cyclone continues for its actual duration after the handoff. At M0, do not count the corresponding-attribute buildup added by M2.

fallback.zh: 风华不够回上步恢复；已不需重放可普通切主攻并跳过提示动作。赋彩不符先检查目标实际浸染。
fallback.en: If Windbloom is insufficient, recover first. If recasting is unnecessary, switch normally and skip prompt entry. For wrong tint, inspect actual Contamination.

signal.zh: 维琳娜上一位主攻：真实快支／连携提示二选一。
signal.en: Previous main attacker before Velina: choose one actual Quick Assist or Chain prompt.

title.zh: 普罗EX取得铁律并挂有罪推定
title.en: Promeia EX grants Absolute Order and applies Presumption of Guilt

input.zh: 有能量点按EX封喉霜径；别为匿影主动吃红光。
input.en: Tap an affordable Glacial Death; do not deliberately take red attacks just to seek Shrouded in Shadow.

trigger.zh: 普罗已回前场，需要铁律、冰积蓄增益或有罪推定。
trigger.en: Promeia is active and needs Absolute Order, Ice buildup buff or Presumption of Guilt.

complete.zh: 发动得铁律并抛披风；EX命中才给目标有罪推定。若真实触发匿影，后续改走重霜。
complete.en: Activation grants Absolute Order and throws the cloak; the EX must hit to apply Presumption of Guilt. If Shrouded in Shadow actually triggers, follow with Layered Frost instead.

reason.zh: 抛披风切割不回寒蚀；匿影需要真实受击时机或极限闪避后足够能量。
reason.en: Cloak cutting does not restore Chill; Shrouded in Shadow needs its real attack timing or enough energy after a Perfect Dodge.

fallback.zh: 没能量可用普通攻击到第四段抛披风、第五段落地；没有铁律就不能把普五称为坠霜。
fallback.en: Without energy, Basic 4 throws the cloak and Basic 5 lands. Without Absolute Order, do not label Basic 5 as Descending Frost.

title.zh: 铁律披风状态下接坠霜落地

input.zh: 持有铁律且处于镣锁赦罪时点普攻或特殊技；真正触发匿影后则使用重霜分支。
input.en: With Absolute Order and Bound Absolution, press Basic or Special; use Layered Frost instead after an actual Shrouded in Shadow trigger.

trigger.zh: 前一步已满足对应状态，不能只因有霜刑就凭空发动坠霜。
trigger.en: The previous action established the required states; Trial by Cold alone does not permit Descending Frost.

complete.zh: 确认下落攻击落地；霜刑够时可长按普攻／特殊技衔接绝裁。
complete.en: Confirm the descending attack lands; enough Trial by Cold permits held Basic/Special into Merciless Judgment.

reason.zh: 坠霜、重霜和普五都提供合法落地接口，但来源条件不同。
reason.en: Descending Frost, Layered Frost and Basic 5 all provide legal landing links, with different entry conditions.

fallback.zh: 没有铁律就改用真实普五落地；没有霜刑先回正常积蓄，不强制追绝裁。
fallback.en: Without Absolute Order, use a real Basic 5 landing. Without Trial, build normally rather than forcing Judgment.

prep.en: When Yuzuha buffs/Sweet Scare need refresh, use the first two opening events to recolor with the main attacker; skip redundant setup.

prep.zh: 普罗需要小爆发时，从坠霜实际落地且有霜刑接爆发中的绝裁步骤；没有资源回积蓄。
prep.en: For a Promeia mini-burst, use the Judgment event after an actual Descending Frost landing with Trial; otherwise build.

label.zh: 爆发窗口
label.en: Burst window

objective.zh: 辅助准备尽量放窗口前，按异常与真实库存倾泻。
objective.en: Prepare support before the window, then spend actual stock against Anomaly.

title.zh: 有真实窗口才用普罗连携
title.en: Use Promeia Chain only when a real prompt exists

input.zh: 实际连携选择中选普罗；需要取消其他后续连携时，按游戏当前取消操作，不承诺能再开第二轮。
input.en: Select Promeia in a real Chain prompt. Cancel later Chains through the game’s current control when appropriate, without assuming a second window can be created.

trigger.zh: 实际提示存在；柚2强制连携与真正失衡要分开判断。
trigger.en: A real prompt exists; distinguish Yuzuha M2 forced Chain from actual Stun.

complete.zh: 重击命中异常目标才结算连携异放；随后可接普五。
complete.en: The heavy hit must land on an Anomalous target for Chain Abloom; Basic 5 is available afterward.

reason.zh: 作者的双连携需要特定Boss及剩余触发机会；本基础轴不硬复刻取消再触发。
reason.en: The author’s double-Chain route needs a suitable Boss and remaining triggers; this baseline does not force a cancel/retrigger sequence.

fallback.zh: 没提示就普通保持／切入普罗并跳过连携；按自己Q或既有霜刑输出。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, stay on or switch normally to Promeia and skip Chain, using her actual Ultimate or Trial stock.

title.zh: 普罗Q结算异放并准备寒誓
title.en: Promeia Ultimate resolves Abloom and grants Frost Oath

input.zh: 自己的Q实际就绪时释放；目标已有属性异常再兑现重击。
input.en: Use her own ready Ultimate and land the heavy hit while the target has an Anomaly.

trigger.zh: 窗口与异常状态允许，普罗喧响足够；无需等待全队Q都好。
trigger.en: The window and Anomaly permit it, and Promeia has enough Decibels; allies need not all be ready.

complete.zh: 发动获得1层寒誓，重击命中异常目标触发异放；寒誓不能叠成多次免费重霜。
complete.en: Activation grants one Frost Oath; a heavy hit on an Anomalous target triggers Abloom. Frost Oath does not stack into multiple free Layered Frost uses.

reason.zh: Q后的重霜是寒誓分支，和被攻击／极限闪避触发的匿影分支分开。
reason.en: The post-Ultimate Layered Frost uses Frost Oath, separate from the attack/Perfect-Dodge Shrouded in Shadow branch.

fallback.zh: Q没好跳过；下一步没有寒誓就用普五落地接口，不空按重霜。
fallback.en: Skip if unready; without Frost Oath, use Basic 5 for the next landing link instead of inventing Layered Frost.

input.zh: Q／绝裁／连携之后，持有寒誓时点按或长按特殊技；本次消耗寒誓接重霜。
input.en: After Ultimate, Judgment or Chain, press/hold Special with Frost Oath; this consumes it for Layered Frost.

trigger.zh: 确有寒誓，且刚完成允许的入口；另一个合法入口是实际触发匿影。
trigger.en: Frost Oath actually exists and a legal preceding move finished; an actual Shrouded in Shadow trigger is the other legal entry.

complete.zh: 重霜下落攻击落地；霜刑足够再接绝裁。
complete.en: Layered Frost’s descending hit lands; follow with Judgment only with enough Trial.

reason.zh: 不因霜刑充足就跳过前置；没有寒誓／匿影不能直接写重霜。
reason.en: Trial stock does not remove entry requirements; no Frost Oath/Shrouded in Shadow means no direct Layered Frost.

fallback.zh: 缺寒誓且没触发匿影：从真实普五落地接后续；霜刑缺则回常态补。
fallback.en: With neither Frost Oath nor Shrouded in Shadow, use a real Basic 5 landing; return to buildup if Trial is missing.

input.en: After Basic 5, Descending Frost or Layered Frost lands, hold Basic/Special with at least one Trial by Cold.

trigger.zh: 合法落地接口、真实霜刑和目标异常同时满足。
trigger.en: A legal landing, actual Trial and target Anomaly all hold.

complete.zh: 发动消耗1霜刑；终结一击命中异常目标才触发异放，绝裁本体命中不累积寒蚀。
complete.en: Activation spends one Trial; the finishing hit must strike an Anomalous target for Abloom. Judgment’s own hit does not build Corrosive Chill.

reason.zh: 霜刑耗尽时从寒蚀实际转化再继续；4影／6影额外回复有各自条件与间隔。
reason.en: Continue only after actual Chill conversion replenishes Trial; M4/M6 refunds have separate conditions/cooldowns.

fallback.zh: 无霜刑先普攻／合法EX积攒；目标异常结束先重建，不把一次绝裁当无限循环。
fallback.en: Without Trial, build with Basics/legal EX. Restore expired Anomaly; one Judgment does not create an infinite loop.

title.zh: 绝裁后接普五，再检查剩余霜刑
title.en: Link Basic 5 after Judgment, then check remaining Trial

input.zh: 绝裁发动后，长按普攻／特殊技或点按普攻直接接普五；落地再按下一步。
input.en: After Judgment, hold Basic/Special or tap Basic to link directly into Basic 5; proceed after landing.

trigger.zh: 上一招确为绝裁；普通快支不自动授予同一普五入口。
trigger.en: The previous move was Judgment; ordinary Quick Assist does not automatically grant this same Basic 5 link.

complete.zh: 普五命中与寒蚀／霜刑按当前显示核对，窗口仍在再继续绝裁。
complete.en: Read Basic 5’s hit and current Chill/Trial; continue Judgment only while the window remains.

reason.zh: 逐次检查资源，避免把“攒满后倾泻”写成固定无限连。
reason.en: Check resources each time rather than treating a stocked burst as a fixed infinite combo.

fallback.zh: 窗口已结束或霜刑缺就回常态；若仍有寒誓，可在合法入口改接一次重霜，不重复赠送寒誓。
fallback.en: Return to normal play when the window or Trial ends. A remaining Frost Oath may permit one legal Layered Frost link, never a free repeated grant.

prep.zh: 尽量在真正失衡前留100寒蚀＋2霜刑，普罗Q看本人就绪；同时确认柚增益、染冰与风异常。来不及满储备就按实际资源缩短，不强等错过窗口。
prep.en: Aim to retain 100 Corrosive Chill plus two Trial by Cold before actual Stun, checking Promeia’s own Ultimate, Yuzuha buffs, Ice color and Wind Anomaly. If stock is incomplete, shorten the sequence rather than waiting through the window.

prep.zh: 连携只按真实提示，不把柚2强制连携当失衡；Q未就绪就用已有资源，不强行等待。
prep.en: Use actual Chain prompts only; Yuzuha M2 forced Chain is not Stun. Spend existing resources when Ultimate is unready rather than waiting idle.

text.zh: 柚1开战加能量不等于每轮免费EX；仍看能量是否够用。
text.en: Yuzuha M1 starting energy is not a free EX every loop; check actual affordability.

text.zh: 柚2重击命中非失衡敌人可按20秒间隔强制连携；快支与连携按真实提示择一，强制连携不是失衡。
text.en: Yuzuha M2 can force a Chain on a heavy hit against a non-Stunned enemy with a 20s cooldown. Choose the actual assist/Chain prompt; forced Chain is not Stun.

text.zh: 维1提高气旋失衡与对应抗性穿透，可能提前进失衡；资源准备未满时不硬套同一秒轴。
text.en: Velina M1 improves Cyclone Daze and specified RES ignoring; Stun may arrive earlier, so do not assume an unchanged timed resource schedule.

text.zh: 维2风化也能回风蚀（5秒间隔），赋彩气旋才增加对应属性积蓄；该额外积蓄不参与异常伤害结算。
text.en: Velina M2 also grants Windbite from Windswept with a 5s cooldown, and tinted Cyclones gain matching-attribute buildup excluded from Anomaly DMG calculations.

text.zh: 维6消耗2风蚀后返1受6秒间隔限制；别把每次乱流都当气旋或返还。
text.en: Velina M6 refunding one after spending two Windbite has a 6s cooldown; not every Vortex summons a Cyclone or refunds.

text.zh: 维专武需两次EX招式造成风伤才叠到2层、给全队精通；同一招多次命中最多记1层。
text.en: Velina’s signature needs Wind damage from two EX uses to reach two stacks and grant team AP; repeated hits within one move count once.

text.zh: 柚专武的全队精通要追加攻击实际命中；有装备不等于增益已生效。
text.en: Yuzuha’s signature team AP needs an actual Aftershock hit; equipping it alone does not activate the buff.

text.zh: 普罗1用Q后有一次霜刑未满时补1机会；满资源开大不直接记第三点，后续看实际库存。
text.en: Promeia M1 has one post-Ultimate opportunity to add Trial when below cap; using Ultimate at full stock does not grant a third point. Read the actual stock afterward.

text.zh: 普罗2加强消耗霜刑的异放；不要给连携或Q异放套同一加成。
text.en: Promeia M2 improves Abloom that consumes Trial; do not apply that same bonus to Chain or Ultimate Abloom.

text.zh: 普罗4异放回5寒蚀受0.5秒间隔；与基础绝裁不回寒蚀的规则分开。
text.en: Promeia M4 restores five Chill from Abloom with a 0.5s cooldown, separate from Judgment not building Chill by its own hit.

text.zh: 普罗6消耗霜刑触发的额外异放与资源回复受15秒间隔，不是每次绝裁双结算。
text.en: Promeia M6 extra Abloom/resource return from Trial spending has a 15s cooldown; not every Judgment doubles its resolution.

text.zh: 普罗专武由冰属性装备者发动特殊／EX叠层，同一招最多1层；2层才有额外异放增益。
text.en: Promeia’s signature gains stacks from an Ice equipper using Special/EX, at most one per use; the additional Abloom buff requires two stacks.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.按提示接主攻：快支／连携择一: 按实际提示选快支或连携

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.快支出现就响应主攻快支；若实际出现连携窗口则选主攻连携。本事件只执行其中一种。: 出现主攻的快支提示时按对应支援键；若是连携选人窗口则选主攻。两种只做一种。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切入维琳娜或完成合法招架后，有能量点按EX扬清；确需再补且能量够，可随后再按: 维琳娜普通入场或成功招架后，能量够就点按强化特殊技补风华；还缺风华且能量够，才再按一次强化特殊技。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.确认风华≥90，长按特殊技或普攻发动风暴眼，随后按主攻实际提示。: 确认风华至少90，长按特殊技或普攻发动风暴眼；看到主攻的入场提示再接。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.有能量点按EX封喉霜径；别为匿影主动吃红光。: 有能量时点按强化特殊技，确保命中；不要为了触发匿影硬吃红光攻击。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.Q／绝裁／连携之后，持有寒誓时点按或长按特殊技；本次消耗寒誓接重霜。: 终结技、绝裁或连携后，持有寒誓时点按或长按特殊技，打出重霜。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普五／坠霜／重霜落地后，霜刑≥1时保持长按普攻或特殊技。: 普攻第五段、坠霜或重霜落地后，至少有1点霜刑才长按普攻或特殊技。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.绝裁发动后，长按普攻／特殊技或点按普攻直接接普五；落地再按下一步。: 绝裁出手后，保持按住普攻／特殊技或点按普攻，可直接接普攻第五段；等落地再继续。
